title: Template Schema
description: Includes the resources of a Codify template. The template's resources are merged into the plan at the position the template is declared.

type.description: All template configs are of the type template

name.description: Optional name. Required to reference the template in dependsOn when multiple templates are declared

source.description: The template to include. Either a registry template name ("nvm"), a profile scoped registry template name ("@codify/nvm"), or a Codify dashboard document id (uuid)

dependsOn.description: Applied to every resource inside the template

os.description: Applied to every resource inside the template

distro.description: Applied to every resource inside the template
